about: The TeX side's browser suites in shards (tex.yml): dev/ci_shards.py --list .github/tex-shards.json runs a shard and gates them, dev/ci_balance.py --list .github/tex-shards.json deals the commands by their p95 (seconds) from main's runs. Every command runs in test/ with dist/tex. paths: the files whose change makes a pull request need TeX (the gate passes without it otherwise).
